newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS says international revenue up in '97.
newsitem.headline: MAS says international revenue up in '97.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) said on Thursday the proportion of revenue from its international flights rose to 80 percent for the year to March 31, 1997, compared to 70 percent in the same period in 1996.

"I can say the international revenue is almost 80 percent, and the domestic is about 20 percent. Last year it was 70/30," said MAS chairman Tajudin Ramli at a news conference after the release of the company's results.
The group's operating profit during the period stood at 349.26 million ringgit, against 250.34 million ringgit for the same period in 1996.
